_help: Every moving part of the real robot and what drives it. All numbers are inches in the ROBOT
frame: +x forward, +y up (0 = floor), +z right, origin = robot center on the floor.
The GLBs in models/robot come from the CAD STEP (sim/cad/robot_mesh.py + robot_export.py),
already in this frame, so they need no scale or rotation.
'pivot' + 'axis' is the hinge, measured from round holes and shafts in the CAD. 'parent' makes
a part ride on another. Drivers: servo (angle at position 0 and 1, degrees from the CAD pose),
spin (motor rpm x scale), turret (sim turret angle).
TUNE = the hinge is measured but the travel/direction is a guess, check against the robot.

parts.name: turret
parts._note: the CAD has the shooter rotated, angleAtForward swings it to face +x when the encoder says forward

parts.name: pollenHood
parts._note: TUNE travel and direction: 15 deg total for the 65-80 deg shot range

parts.name: gate
parts._note: hinge is the Mini Axon spline. TUNE: assumes the CAD pose is closed, open travel is a guess

parts.name: intake
parts._note: TUNE: assumes the CAD pose is deployed (position 0), stowed travel is a guess

parts.name: flower
parts._note: the CAD pose is stowed (position 0). -102.5 deg puts the lowest point of the mesh on the floor, 14.9 in ahead of center
